notes.title: Volume 2
notes.notes:
Just wanted to give a quick update. 

At least as of right now, I'm looking to have Volume 2 completed and imported to steam, by the last week of February. 



[i][u][b]EDIT: 2/27/2025 [/b][/u][/i] - It'll probably be another week or two. After a few replays of volume 2, I feel like I needed to redo a little at the beginning of volume 2.

notes.title: Volume 2
notes.notes:
[i]First of all, let me start by thanking everyone for your interest and feedback. I've spent a lot of weekends on this project and as this is my first game it's been a pretty fun and terrifying experience. I always wanted to emphasize the story aspect of this project, so I'm learning a lot and I can say for sure that it'll help me grow. [/i]

Now, to keep this short and to the point. 

-Volume 2 will be an [u][b]UPDATE[/b][/u]. 

-To clarify, Volume 2 will not be anything in the form of "paying for it". If you already own the base game, it will just update itself to volume 2 from the steam library.

notes.title: Jan. 17, 2025 - Minor Update v1.3
notes.notes:
There seemed to be an issue this morning with steam community which stopped me from viewing or editing anything on my community page. So I hope this works properly.

However. I would like to thank you for your input and feed back.
This is my first project and It's something I did over the course of a lot of weekends. So, to see the response it got, both the positive and the negative are great for me as it will help me grow. 

I fixed a few issues and added a few QoL changes.

-Fixed an issue with the mini-game(timer).

-Fixed a translation error with Chinese "name" being incorrect.

-Fixed minor-spelling error that prevented Isabelle and Gabrielles achievement from activating.

-"Who's a SIMP? Not me!" will now properly activate properly.

-"Voice In The Dark" will now activate properly.
--- Due take note that this is a "hidden" achievement. Anything and everything up to it, isn't displayed in the game. It's not a bug or anything. It's intended.

-Added a gallery button on the top left of the main menu screen. (Gallery needs to be unlocked to see it.)

-Added "Skip Text" in options menu.

-Added "Rollback" in options menu.
